plan.title: Donations Summary
plan.subtitle: Summary of donations received this year

panels.title: Total donations
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM donor_transactions WHERE date_part('year', "Date") = date_part('year', CURRENT_DATE)

panels.title: Donations by city
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions WHERE date_part('year', "Date") = date_part('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly donations
panels.sql: SELECT date_part('month', "Date") AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE date_part('year', "Date") = date_part('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 cities by donations
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions WHERE date_part('year', "Date") = date_part('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: Donations this year have increased by {{p1}} compared to last year. The top 10 cities by donations are {{p4.n}}. The monthly donations trend is shown in the line chart above. We have received donations through {{p2.n}} different cities. The most common mode of donation is {{p2.x}}.
